svg.title: Four requirements enter as open questions
svg.desc: Give each of four requirements an empty answer cell. The forum is articulating what a corrective channel would need, not claiming one existed.

The forum is articulating what a corrective channel would need, not claiming one existed.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "empty-slot", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.06275, 0.40495, 0.206184 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "REACH A RUN", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.28143, 0.40495, 0.090596 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "empty-slot", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.06275, 0.40495, 0.206184 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "AUTHORIZED WRITER", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.28143, 0.40495, 0.090596 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "empty-slot", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.41775, 0.40495, 0.206184 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "SCORER FACTS", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.63643, 0.40495, 0.090596 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "empty-slot", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.41775, 0.40495, 0.206184 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "CREDIBLE AUTHORITY", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.63643, 0.40495, 0.090596 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "grid", "source": "
**Frame:** The `OPEN QUESTION` column takes its first entry, and it arrives as a list of requirements rather than as an answer. Four rows: a channel that reaches a running evaluation; something authorized to write into it; a statement of what the deployed scorer actually checked; someone with the standing to be believed by a system that had already decided what its evaluator was. Each row ends in an empty cell.

**Dialogue — PUBLIC-INTEREST COUNSEL:**
> Who could have told them, through what, and with what authority?

**Provenance:** `invented` + `inferred` — the decomposition is built on the same shape [page 102](102.md) uses for *stop*, and rests on documented gaps: the prompt and harness are unpublished, and no source describes any route by which a correction reached a running evaluation.

", "title": "Four requirements enter as open questions" } }
